entry.name: startPadding
entry.label: Space in px before the logo button. With the Plasma Fusion top bar (6 px panel margin) the default puts the button 10 px from the screen edge, as on the board.

entry.name: endPadding
entry.label: Space in px after the application name, before the next widget (the global menu). The board has 10 px of padding and a 2 px gap; the panel adds its own applet spacing, so 7 gives the board's distance to the first menu title.

entry.name: maximumNameWidth
entry.label: Longest application name in px; longer names are elided.
